summary: Iteration 9 frontend-only tests passed. Theme toggle works (dark/light switch, html class swap, body bg becomes slate-50 rgb(248,250,252), localStorage 'ofOps.theme' persists across reload). Select dropdown options are readable at rest in both themes: dark mode text color rgb(226,232,240) (slate-200), light mode rgb(15,23,42) (slate-900 via html.light overrides). Hover/highlight background shows cyan tint rgba(6,182,212,0.15); selected item bg rgba(6,182,212,0.1). Verified for ship-status-select (3 options: Planned/Booked/Shipped), ship-carrier-select (9 carriers), and client-company-select (Patuma/Clearfreight). No regression: mark-second-sailed button still present on Flange 2000 shipment row, data loads correctly.

issues: Hover text color stays slate-200 (rgb(226,232,240)) instead of transitioning to cyan-200. Cause: 'dark:text-slate-200' variant in select.jsx line 86 has same specificity but comes later than 'hover:text-cyan-200', so it wins. Background hover tint still applies correctly, so options remain readable/identifiable - visibility spec met, but the text-color-on-hover per spec isn't visually taking effect. Fix: remove the redundant 'dark:text-slate-200' (base 'text-slate-200' already covers dark) OR reorder classes / use !important on hover text.

action_items: (Low priority) Fix SelectItem hover text color: 'dark:text-slate-200' overrides 'hover:text-cyan-200' in select.jsx line 86. Drop the dark: duplicate or add data-[highlighted] winning specificity.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeProvider default 'dark' good; localStorage read is SSR-safe.

AppShell uses 'light:bg-slate-50' etc. Tailwind does not have a built-in 'light:' variant by default; those class prefixes may be no-ops. The actual light theme currently works only because of the html.light !important overrides in index.css. Confirm tailwind.config.js registers 'light' as a variant, otherwise the 'light:*' Tailwind class names in AppShell are dead code (harmless but misleading).
select.jsx SelectItem: hover:text-cyan-200 shadowed by dark:text-slate-200 due to class order; consider explicit '&:hover' or restructure.

rca of the issue: For the minor hover-text nit: In select.jsx SelectItem className, order is 'text-slate-200 dark:text-slate-200 ... hover:bg-cyan-500/15 hover:text-cyan-200 ...'. Tailwind's dark: variant emits after hover: variant in the generated CSS, giving 'dark:text-slate-200' higher cascade priority when html.dark is set. So on hover under dark theme, background does tint cyan but text stays slate. Fix by removing the duplicate 'dark:text-slate-200' (base class already sets it) OR by using an arbitrary variant that wins specificity.
